scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run i18n:audit && npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run i18n:audit && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.build:render: npm ci && npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && npm run lint --prefix frontend --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend --if-present
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:migrate:verify: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:verify
